supported_scope: /rewind (alias /undo) rolls conversation history back to a previous message; /fork branches the session. The CLI changelog describes rewind reverting workspace snapshots.
unestablished_scope: Recovery of shell side effects, external actions and deployed resources
File restoration is described in the changelog, not in the main command documentation
constraints: Changelog: edits with diffs over 1 MiB skip the elided diff during /rewind reverts

evidence.quote: Roll back your conversation history to a previous message

evidence.section: Antigravity CLI > Session-scoped Remote Control, unlimited headless run timeouts, structured error reporting, and artifact text selection
evidence.quote: Fixed /rewind conversation reverts and forks sweeping backward to an older workspace snapshot
